name: search
description: Search the paper library. BM25 over ~300-word chunks of every paper section except References, plus each paper's title and abstract. Returns up to k hits, best first, as a JSON list of {paper_id, title, section, snippet, score}. Several hits can come from the same paper.

query.description: Keywords or a short natural-language query.

name: read
description: Read a paper's text. With a section name, returns that section; section numbers are optional, so 'Results' finds '4 Results'. Without a section, returns the whole paper, which can be 50k+ tokens, so prefer list_sections and read one section at a time. read(paper_id, 'References') returns the bibliography.

paper_id.description: Corpus paper ID (an arXiv number such as 2210.03629).

section.description: Section name from list_sections. Omit for the whole paper.

name: list_sections
description: List a paper's section names, in order.

name: get_metadata
description: A paper's title, authors, year and abstract.
